chat.noInstalledModel: No models to chat with yet — download one first

err.notload: Model not loaded — press Load, or download it
err.worker: Engine worker crashed and was recycled — retry
err.param: Request parameters rejected — check the model selection
err.missing: Model not installed — download it first
err.memload: Not enough memory to load this model — try a smaller model or free memory
err.gpu: No GPU device — run edge0 diagnostics to check the environment
err.version: Service version mismatch — restart it from the status page

settings.title: Settings
settings.kicker: Tune edge0 appearance and local service access
settings.appearanceNote: Theme and font size apply across the app immediately.
settings.systemPromptNote: Optional instructions sent before each chat. Leave blank to disable.
settings.systemPromptDisabled: No system prompt will be sent
settings.serviceNote: View a compact summary; full controls, logs, and diagnostics live in the service console.
settings.advancedNote: Advanced service actions, request logs, and diagnostics live in the service console.

gen.hint: Generation style: sampling temperature (Precise 0.2 / Balanced 0.7 / Creative 1.0), applied from the next message.

models.title: Models & Downloads
models.kicker: Manage models, keep them loaded, and track downloads
models.stale: Couldn't refresh the model list. You can browse installed models, but downloads are paused.
models.bundledHint: Shipped with this app build; delete is disabled.
models.deleteConfirm: Delete this model? Run `edge0 gc` in Terminal to free space used by files no longer needed by any model.

err.net: Couldn't connect to the download provider. Check your network and try again.
err.src: Couldn't reach either download provider. Try again later or switch networks.
err.disk: Not enough disk space — free space and try again, or choose a smaller model.
err.hash: Downloaded files failed integrity checks from both providers. Delete this task and try again.
err.sig: The model catalog could not be verified. Do not bypass this check; try again later.
err.expired: The model catalog is out of date. You can browse installed models, but try downloads again later.
err.minver: This model needs a newer version of edge0. Update the app and try again.
err.conflict: This model is being used by another request. Wait or cancel the request, then try again.
err.invalid: Model files do not match the installation record. They may be damaged or changed; delete the model and download it again.
